images.filename: Elgin Cathedral from Newmill Road.jpg
images.caption: The historic ruins of Elgin Cathedral, dating back to the 13th century, was once the seat of the Bishop of Moray. The photograph is taken from the south-west on Newmill Road, next to the Landshut bridge.

images.filename: Duke of Gordon's Monument Up Close, Elgin.jpg
images.caption: The Duke of Gordon's Monument sits at the top of Lady Hill in Elgin, Moray. It commonerates George Gordon, the 5th Duke of Gordon, and took its modern form in 1855.
images.alt: The Duke of Gordon's Monument sits at the top of Lady Hill in Elgin, Moray. It commonerates George Gordon, the 5th Duke of Gordon, and took its modern form in 1855.

images.filename: Elgin Pillar South Face.jpg
images.caption: The Elgin Pillar is a Pictish stone located in Elgin, Moray. Originally found in 1823 underneath the St Giles' Church, it is now located in Elgin Cathedral. It is believed to originate from the 9th century.
images.alt: The Elgin Pillar is a Pictish stone located in Elgin, Moray. Originally found in 1823 underneath the St Giles' Church, it is now located in Elgin Cathedral. It is believed to originate from the 9th century.
